content.title: Josh Hart Career Highs For All Stats
content.text: Josh Hart's career high is 44 points, which he scored on Mar 12, 2022 against the Washington Wizards in a 127-118 win for the Trail Blazers. He went 15/21 from the field and 8/8 from the line. What is Josh Hart's career high in rebounds? Josh Hart's high for rebounds in a game is 20 (2 offensive, 18 defensive), which he grabbed on Mar 7, 2025 against the Los Angeles Clippers. What is Josh Hart's career high in assists? The most assists Josh Hart has had in a game was 12, first achieved against the Dallas Mavericks on Feb 8, 2024. Hart has had 12 assists in a game 3 times overall. What is Josh Hart's career high in steals? The most steals Josh Hart has had in a game was 5, first accomplished against the Dallas Mavericks on Jan 7, 2019. Hart has had 5 steals in a game twice overall. What is Josh Hart's career high in blocks? The most blocks Josh Hart has had in a game was 3, first set against the Cleveland Cavaliers on Nov 21, 2018. Hart has had 3 blocks in a game 4 times overall. What is Josh Hart's career high in three-pointers made? Josh Hart went 7/9 against the Clippers on Apr 11, 2018, setting his career high in 3PM.
